name: Felt Daisy Bouquet
description:
A bunch of five white felt daisies, each with layered petals and a hand-felted golden wool centre. They never wilt, so they make a cheerful year-round bouquet for a vase, a desk or a windowsill.

One of a kind: you'll receive the bouquet shown in the photo.

name: Blush Felt Rose Kissing Ball
description:
A hanging pomander covered in hand-rolled blush-pink felt roses, finished with a gold cord loop for hanging. Lovely in a nursery, above a doorway, as a holiday ornament or as a wedding keepsake.

One of a kind: you'll receive the kissing ball shown in the photo.

name: Champagne Crystal Beaded Tassel
description:
A hand-strung tassel of golden bugle beads and faceted champagne crystals that catch the light and throw little rainbows. Hang it in a window, from a lamp or on a tree branch.

One of a kind: you'll receive the tassel shown in the photo.

name: Striped Hat Gnome with Felt Rose
description:
A friendly gnome in a tall knitted grey-and-cream striped hat, with a long silver beard, a wooden bead nose and a purple felt rose. A sweet shelf companion and a thoughtful little gift.

One of a kind: you'll receive the gnome shown in the photo.
